additional_context: Liam is our second child. He started walking at 14 months, which is later than his older sister. He says about 10 words but doesn't combine them yet. He's generally a happy kid but can be particular about certain things. His sister was much more social at this age, which has made us a little curious.

1_point_follow.detail: Usually yes, but sometimes he seems more interested in my hand than where I'm pointing. It's inconsistent.

2_deaf_concern.detail: No, we've never worried about his hearing. He hears us fine.

3_pretend_play.detail: Not really. He likes pushing his cars around but doesn't really pretend with them. He mostly lines them up or spins the wheels.

4_climbing.detail: Yes, he likes climbing on the couch and playground equipment.

6_point_request.detail: Yes, he points when he wants something, though sometimes he just leads me by the hand to what he wants.

7_point_share.detail: Hmm, not really. He doesn't really point to show me things just for the sake of sharing. Only when he wants something.

8_interest_children.detail: He watches other kids at the park, though he doesn't really try to play with them much. He seems interested from a distance.

9_showing_objects.detail: Not often. He doesn't really bring things to show me. He prefers to play on his own.

10_response_name.detail: Usually, yes. Sometimes it takes a couple of calls, but he does respond.

11_social_smile.detail: Yes, he smiles back at us. He's got a sweet smile.

12_noise_sensitivity.detail: Actually yes - he really doesn't like the vacuum cleaner or the blender. He covers his ears and gets upset.

13_walking.detail: Yes, he walks fine now. Started at 14 months.

14_eye_contact.detail: Yes, though maybe not as much as his sister did. But he does look at us.

15_imitation.detail: Sometimes. He'll copy clapping and waving, but not as much as I'd expect.

16_gaze_follow.detail: I'm not sure he does this consistently. Sometimes he seems to, but often he doesn't seem to notice where I'm looking.

17_attention_seeking.detail: Yes, he does like when we watch him do things.

18_understanding.detail: He understands basic instructions, especially routine ones like 'time for bed'.

19_social_referencing.detail: I don't think so. When something new happens, he doesn't really look to me for a reaction.

20_movement_activities.detail: Yes, he enjoys being swung at the park.
